what: Bento grid — each card’s cell count (width·height) and position are set per width (4-col row 280px · 4-col 180 · 2-col 164 · 2-col 136, 16px gap) and placed on that board. Changing the filter (fx:filter or data-filter) moves every card to the layout for that category, shifting left·top in .5s ease, and cards outside the category fade to opacity .25. On wide screens cards can be dragged — a rounded placeholder appears at the drop spot, overlapped cards are pushed away and gaps fill upward (react-grid-layout vertical compaction). For the first .5s cards settle in place without movement

options.gap: Gap between cards / inner padding of the board (px), default 16
options.dim: Opacity of cards outside the category, default .25
options.drag: If off, dragging is disabled (even on wide screens)
options.cancel: Child css (input fields etc.) that should not start a drag, default none (original)
options.[data-fx-part=layouts]: Layout JSON — <script type="application/json"> At { Filter: { lg|md|sm: [{ i, x, y, w, h }] } }
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Card — data-key (i in the layout) · data-tags (categories it belongs to, space-separated for several)
options.--fx-placeholder · --fx-radius · --fx-li: While dragging: placeholder color, card corners, lifted shadow (via style)
